question: The Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK) screens children from birth to 18 years for four categories of conditions known as the 4Ds: Birth Defects, Diseases, Deficiencies, and Developmental Delays (including Disabilities).

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. RBSK uses the '4Ds' framework: Birth Defects (congenital), Diseases (including conditions like dental caries, skin conditions), Deficiencies (anaemia, vitamin D deficiency), and Developmental Delays including Disabilities. All four categories are screened across 30 conditions in children from birth to 18 years.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The RBSK 4Ds mnemonic (Birth Defects, Diseases, Deficiencies, Developmental Delays/Disabilities) covers all 30 common childhood conditions screened under this NHM programme. RBSK mobile health teams screen children at sub-centres, anganwadis, and government schools.
